title: Staff Response and Intervention in Incidences of Molestation on MRT Premises
what_it_is: Staff Response and Intervention in Incidences of Molestation on MRT Premises

sections.label: Staff alert Police after incident
sections.summary: Staff informed the OCC and TransCom was alerted, enabling Police to later arrest a male suspect.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The staff informed the Singapore Bus Service Transit Operations Control Centre (OCC), and the Public Transport Security Command of the Singapore Police Force (TransCom) was alerted immediately.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Their swift actions enabled the Police to subsequently arrest a male suspect.

sections.label: Protocol for staff response
sections.summary: The protocol does not instruct staff to give chase; they first call OCC and TransCom for help and exercise judgement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The protocol, without going into too many details, does not specifically instruct the staff to give chase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The first thing that the staff have to do is, of course, inform the network of support structures that we have, such as the OCC and TransCom, in case more resources and more assets are required to be deployed to the station.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And certainly, the staff has a duty to the station and the responsibilities of the post as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, calling for help is the first part of the protocol.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And these are service staff of our Public Transport Operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They are not trained to handle violent criminals and chase down and apprehend people like that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, they also have to exercise some judgement about what intervention is appropriate for them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Certainly, there is a significant amount of customer service training that the service staff undergo, including how to handle people who are victims of incidences like this.
